name: Open Guard Reading Cut
description: Holds the straight sword in open guard and answers the foe's first movement with one measured cut through the opening.
first_area: Area 01 — The Hour on the West Platform (Ref: 1.1.1.001.01)

name: Argent Crossbar
description: Turns the blade across an incoming edge so the force slides off the flat and leaves the wielder balanced.

name: Silvered Glissade
description: Waits until the foe has committed and then closes one pace inside the line of the blade.

name: Burnished Envelop
description: Catches the foe's blade on the quillon and holds it there with steady pressure while the point stays free.

name: Polished Riposte
description: Lengthens the guard by half a pace and sends the point straight through the foe's chosen defense.

name: Unflawed Quillon
description: Wheels the straight sword in a ring of qi that turns aside blows from the front and both flanks.

name: Exacting Cutover
description: Spirals the blade round the foe's weapon and presses it out of line until the grip loosens.

name: Starkest Beat
description: Draws one level cut across the field of the stance so every foe inside the reach meets the edge.

name: Impeccable Forte
description: Drives one thrust on a line of pure intent that passes through guard and armor and the body behind them.

name: Meticulous Tang
description: Stands the blade upright before the wielder so that blows meeting it return along the line they came.

name: Scrupulous Feint
description: Crosses the gap in one flash the instant the foe's weight shifts and arrives with the point already set.

name: Exquisite Midrib
description: Holds the final cut back through a chain of feints and then spends it whole at the chosen moment.

name: Elegant Pommel
description: Plants the straight sword point-down before the wielder and raises a standing ward whose strength follows the qi given.

name: Refined Leaf
description: Raises the straight sword and brings down one cut of sovereign force across open ground to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.

name: Austere Fuller
description: Delivers one committed thrust that carries a line of ruin to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.
